items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: In that year we did every music festival in the world I think. I don’t think we missed one, there was Montreux, the North Sea, and in Japan. Joe Williams did most of them.

ctx.x: You know when I was with the Basie band. I joined, I’d been with them for a year. In that year we did every music festival in the world I think. I don’t think we missed one, there was Montreux, the North Sea, and in Japan. Joe Williams did most of them. We did the Norman Granz tour. And I was fortunate to be on all of those records — I mean all those festivals with Count Basie. But I had to leave because they weren’t paying much money you know. But yeah, I got to know Joe Williams real good. He was a good friend…
He’s a good friend of this college. He actually helped get this interview project started back in 1995.
